headline: Minnesota 2026: roster, TIP join, portraits, markets, local pages and registry are built; TIP gap list awaits owner approval. Nothing deployed.

stages.title: Roster reconciled to the official listing (or the best labeled source)
stages.note: Parsed from The Green Papers (labeled not official); Secretary of State list behind a captcha, not read. 3 governor, 5 Senate and 17 House rows.

stages.title: TIP export and join
stages.note: TIP export and join: 23 of 25 candidates linked.

stages.title: TIP gap list shown to the owner; approved fixes applied
stages.note: Gap list written; TIP write script prepared and NOT run (needs owner approval).

stages.title: Portraits (licensed only; monograms otherwise)
stages.note: 9 licensed portraits found; 11 candidates show monograms.

stages.title: Kalshi markets
stages.note: Kalshi governor, Senate and 8 House events captured 2026-10-31; MN-01 is the close seat.

stages.title: State pages built locally (hub, governor, Senate, House directory, districts)
stages.note: Built locally (225 pages, 0 violations). Not deployed, no state tile on the homepage yet, no governor hero.

stages.note: data/candidates/MN.json written and registry --check OK; 12 gap flags.
